data.name: You are the light – An Audiovisual VR Journey
data.detailed_description:
Step into a handcrafted, procedurally rendered VR experience of light, sky, and weather.

You stand on a small rocky platform surrounded by grass and flowers, while different moods and worlds unfold above you — from gentle morning colors and vivid daylight to rain with lightning, and finally a calm night filled with stars, auroras, and shooting stars.

Each scene is emotionally and musically choreographed: light, particles, and atmosphere react directly to the dynamics of the sound, creating a coherent audio-visual journey.

Total duration: 15 minutes.

Features:

  • 4 scenes: Morning, Midday, Rain (with lightning), Night (stars, auroras, shooting stars)

  • Music-synchronized particle choreography with evolving patterns

  • Comfortable experience: stationary perspective without artificial locomotion — suitable for seated and standing play (Room-Scale optional)

  • Intuitive VR controls: direct scene selection via menu (laser pointer), pause, and forward/backward navigation

  • Quality presets (Low / Medium / High / Ultra) for a wide range of GPUs

  • OpenXR-based (compatible with SteamVR and OpenXR headsets)

data.short_description: “You Are the Light” is a procedural VR audio-visual experience that takes you through four scenes — Morning, Midday, Rain, and Night — on an emotional journey of light and music, where glowing particles form an immersive, musically choreographed light show in sync with the sound.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR required. Tested with SteamVR OpenXR runtime (Quest 3 via Steam Link). Should work with SteamVR-compatible OpenXR headsets (Valve Index, HTC Vive, Windows Mixed Reality)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR required. Tested with SteamVR OpenXR runtime (Quest 3 via Steam Link). Should work with SteamVR-compatible OpenXR headsets (Valve Index, HTC Vive, Windows Mixed Reality)
